import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = (1 << 19) + 5;
    static int N, K, MOD, MAX_VAL;
    static int[] popcnt = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] DP = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] buffer1 = new int[20][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] buffer2 = new int[20][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] buffer3 = new int[20][MAX_SIZE];
    static long MOD_SQUARED;
    static long[][] temp = new long[20][MAX_SIZE];
    static long[] factorial = new long[MAX_SIZE];
    static long[] inv_factorial = new long[MAX_SIZE];

    static long power_mod(long base, long exponent) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exponent > 0) {
            if ((exponent & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exponent >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static void setup() {
        factorial[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            factorial[i] = factorial[i-1] * i % MOD;
        inv_factorial[MAX_VAL] = power_mod(factorial[MAX_VAL], MOD - 2);
        for (int i = MAX_VAL - 1; i >= 0; --i)
            inv_factorial[i] = inv_factorial[i+1] * (i+1) % MOD;
    }

    static int next_power_of_two(int x) {
        int p = 1;
        while (p < x) p <<= 1;
        return p;
    }

    static void fast_walsh_hadamard(int[] data, int length, boolean inverse) {
        long[] temp_array = new long[MAX_SIZE];
        for (int i = 0; i < length; ++i) temp_array[i] = data[i];
        
        if (inverse) {
            for (int step = 1; step < length; step <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < length; i += step << 1) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < step; ++j) {
                        long a = temp_array[i + j];
                        long b = temp_array[i + j + step];
                        temp_array[i + j + step] = (a - b) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int step = 1; step < length; step <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < length; i += step << 1) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < step; ++j) {
                        long a = temp_array[i + j];
                        long b = temp_array[i + j + step];
                        temp_array[i + j + step] = (a + b) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < length; ++i) {
            data[i] = (int)(temp_array[i] % MOD);
            if (data[i] < 0) data[i] += MOD;
        }
    }

    static void reduce_mod(long[] x, int index) {
        if (x[index] >= MOD_SQUARED) x[index] -= MOD_SQUARED;
    }

    static void transform_multiply() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(buffer1[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(temp[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            buffer1[popcnt[i]][i] = DP[i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fast_walsh_hadamard(buffer1[i], MAX_VAL + 1, false);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int l = 0; q + l <= 19; ++l)
                for (int s = 0; s <= MAX_VAL; ++s)
                    reduce_mod(temp[q + l], s);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int l = 0; q + l <= 19; ++l)
                for (int s = 0; s <= MAX_VAL; ++s)
                    temp[q + l][s] += 1L * buffer1[q][s] * buffer2[l][s];
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int s = 0; s <= MAX_VAL; ++s)
                buffer3[q][s] = (int)(temp[q][s] % MOD);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fast_walsh_hadamard(buffer3[i], MAX_VAL + 1, true);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            DP[i] = buffer3[popcnt[i]][i];
    }

    static void transform_square() {
        int[][] temp_buffer = new int[20][MAX_SIZE];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(temp[i], 0);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int l = 0; q + l <= 19; ++l)
                for (int s = 0; s <= MAX_VAL; ++s)
                    reduce_mod(temp[q + l], s);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int l = 0; q + l <= 19; ++l)
                for (int s = 0; s <= MAX_VAL; ++s)
                    temp[q + l][s] += 1L * buffer2[q][s] * buffer2[l][s];
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int s = 0; s <= MAX_VAL; ++s)
                temp_buffer[q][s] = (int)(temp[q][s] % MOD);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fast_walsh_hadamard(temp_buffer[i], MAX_VAL + 1, true);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(buffer2[i], 0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            buffer2[popcnt[i]][i] = temp_buffer[popcnt[i]][i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fast_walsh_hadamard(buffer2[i], MAX_VAL + 1, false);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        K = sc.nextInt();
        MOD = sc.nextInt();
        MOD_SQUARED = 1L * MOD * MOD;
        
        if ((N & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(power_mod(K, N));
            return;
        }
        
        DP[0] = 1;
        MAX_VAL = next_power_of_two(N + 1) - 1;
        setup();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            popcnt[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            buffer2[popcnt[i]][i] = (int)inv_factorial[i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fast_walsh_hadamard(buffer2[i], MAX_VAL + 1, false);
        
        int original_K = K;
        while (K > 0) {
            if ((K & 1) == 1) transform_multiply();
            K >>= 1;
            if (K > 0) transform_square();
        }
        
        long result = (power_mod(original_K, N) - factorial[N] * DP[N] % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
